# Automatiseerimine.ee

Automatiseerimine.ee is an Estonian-language site by Ettevõtluskeskus OÜ for micro and small business owners who want to reduce repetitive manual work.

Primary audience: older or non-technical Estonian business owners.

Main promise: identify one repeated business task that can be simplified with automation or AI, without starting from technical jargon.

Core services:
- Free 10-minute quick check via 02Signal
- 490 EUR + VAT owner advisory session
- Automation start plan from 1,900 EUR + VAT

Useful links:
- Homepage: https://automatiseerimine.ee/
- Quick check: https://02signal.ai/et/kiirkontroll/?utm_source=automatiseerimine.ee&utm_medium=microsite&utm_campaign=automatiseerimine
- Privacy: https://automatiseerimine.ee/privaatsus/
- Contact: info@02signal.ai, +372 5818 0435
